description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a single PUT endpoint that updates an item. It includes a Pydantic model for item validation and demonstrates the use of OpenAPI examples in request body annotations.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item with optional description and tax fields, and required name and price fields.

methods.name: update_item( *, item_id: int, item: Annotated[ Item, Body( openapi_examples={ "normal": { "summary": "A normal example", "description": "A **normal** item works correctly.", "value": { "name": "Foo", "description": "A very nice Item", "price": 35.4, "tax": 3.2, }, }, "converted": { "summary": "An example with converted data", "description": "FastAPI can convert price `strings` to actual `numbers` automatically", "value": { "name": "Bar", "price": "35.4", }, }, "invalid": { "summary": "Invalid data is rejected with an error", "value": { "name": "Baz", "price": "thirty five point four", }, }, }, ), ], )
methods.description: An asynchronous endpoint handler for updating an item, which uses annotated request body with OpenAPI examples.
